d.ko: Take the helm in this realistic, large-scale maritime simulation. Command your fleet from agile rescue vessels to massive LNG tankers and perform precise maneuvers in challenging conditions. Navigate a living open world where weather, traffic, and every wave shape your career.
d.en: Take the helm in this realistic, large-scale maritime simulation. Command your fleet from agile rescue vessels to massive LNG tankers and perform precise maneuvers in challenging conditions. Navigate a living open world where weather, traffic, and every wave shape your career.
d.zh: 在这款沉浸式海上模拟中全面掌控。每艘船通过真实系统操作，无街机捷径。从推进与导航到环境力量，你的成功依赖技能和注意力，专为热爱模拟的玩家设计。
